messages:
acme-cs: Hey team, customer (Acme Corp) reporting regressions after yesterday's rollout (variant-b). Model used to call our `fetch_invoice` tool reliably; now ~30% of calls either omit `invoice_id` or don't call the tool at all and return a plain text response. They started after the 23:40 deploy. They provided a repro.
maria_s: thanks — can you paste the repro request/response and a request id? we'll triage.
acme-cs: repro curl below. note the expected tool call in `tool_calls` (invoice_id present). In failing runs `tool_calls` is empty or present but args:null.
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"open-redwood-v1.2","input":"Get latest invoice for user 98321 and fetch it via fetch_invoice","tools":[{"name":"fetch_invoice","schema":{"invoice_id":"string"}}],"metadata":{"customer":"acme","trace_id":"req-ACME-20260317-01"}}'
```
acme-cs: failing response snippet (one example):
```json
{"id":"resp-xyz","output":"Here is the invoice summary...","tool_calls":[]}
```
and a variant where tool call present but args null:
```json
{"id":"resp-abc","output":"Attempting to fetch...","tool_calls":[{"name":"fetch_invoice","args":null}]}
```
maria_s: ugh. did they pin model to a variant? was this only after canary -> primary swap?
acme-cs: they said they noticed it after you flipped the canary to variant-b at ~23:40 UTC. They tried re-sending the same prompt multiple times; some attempts work, others don't.
support-bot: deploy-bot posted: rollout variant-b to prod completed 2026-03-16T23:38:12Z (commit sha: f9b2c3a). Canary -> primary switchover automated.
devon_r: can we get the full request_ids for a couple of failures? need model_request_id and runtime logs. also what model variant exact name? int8/inference config?
acme-cs: they gave two request ids: req-ACME-20260317-01 (works) and req-ACME-20260317-02 (fails). variant reported: open-redwood-v1.2-int8-variant-b
devon_r: possible hypothesis: the new kernel selection path for quantized variant changed the tool-calling tokenization offsets so the tool-call detection heuristics miss the call or strip args. Ingrid, could this be due to updated tokenizer/truncation handling in the adapter layer?
ingrid_m: yes, we shipped a truncation-preserving optimizer that rewrites prompt fragments to reduce kv-cache pressure. If prompt slicing moved the tool args to a different buffer segment, our tool-call post-processor might not see the arg tokens. I'll reproduce locally with the quantized kernel and the same prompt.
maria_s: action items: 1) devon/ingrid reproduce with req ids above and share small repro binary, 2) set customer workaround (pin to open-redwood-v1.1 or previous variant) — acme can you confirm you can pin? 3) we'll consider rolling back the canary if reproduction is quick.
acme-cs: they pinned to open-redwood-v1.1 and that restored tool calls. please escalate, customer is on a time-sensitive billing run.
devon_r: thanks — I'm starting a debug run now. quick check: do we have any gateway proxies that might be stripping JSON args for tool calls (e.g., content-length chunking)?
ingrid_m: unlikely given workarounds, but I'll watch for serialization diffs. also will enable debug parsing logs on the adapter for those request ids.
maria_s: I'll create a Priority P1 ticket and mark for rollback if we see repro within 30m. keep me posted in-thread.
acme-cs: thanks — customer appreciates quick response. they provided one more failing partial transcript where model says: "I'm going to fetch that for you" then stops and returns plain text.
devon_r: noted. I'll post back with runtime traces (kernel selection, token offsets, post-processor output). if confirmed, plan is temporary rollback of variant-b and a fix in the post-processor to use token-aligned arg extraction.
maria_s: copying product and oncall. :thumbsup:
